Closer in, you will find movies, shopping, dining and a host of other destinations within walking distance of the hotel.

Onsite, we have custom crafted many features and amenities to ensure your stay is comfortable and memorable. Surrounding the hotel is a lush wrap of tropical, Florida landscaping, Royal, Queen and Christmas Palms, colorful blooming foliage and deep leafy greens mixed with delightful, variegated varieties along pavered walkways.

Once inside the lobby you are met with vibrant local colors, brilliant greens and reds accented by fine tiles and hardwoods. From our expanded dining and internet cafe to state-of-the-art fitness and meeting facilities, to cool breezes on the lanai overlooking the pool and waterfall, Hampton Inn & Suites-Homestead captures the all flair and feel of this top, international destination.

description:
Hollywood is a classic Florida beachtown that’s enchanted visitors since the 1920s. Visitors love the Hollywood Trolley which provides a scenic way to enjoy the best of Hollywood Beach and Downtown. Hollywood Beach features a one-of-a-kind oceanfront promenade called the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk that stretches nearly two and a half miles along the Atlantic. Named one of America’s Best Beach Boardwalk’s by Travel + Leisure magazine, this brick-paved thoroughfare is a haven for joggers, bicyclists, roller-bladers and all who’d prefer to take in the action from the comfort of one of the countless eateries and café’s along the way.

The easy ocean access and village-like feel make this a can’t miss destination with numerous highly-rated restaurants, small inns and hotels right on the broadwalk adding to its yesteryear charm. Family dining becomes stress-free, as Mom’s and Dad’s kick back to enjoy a seaside meal while their little ones entertain themselves in the sand just steps away. Two broadwalk parks attract kids of all ages to play paddleball at the historic Garfield Street courts or cool off in the whimsical dolphin play fountain. Locals rave about Josh’s Organic Market which sets up shop on the south end of the Hollywood Broadwalk every weekend selling garden fresh produce and blending a variety of mouth-watering exotic, tropical smoothies from its seaside stand. City leaders recently voted to move forward with a public/private partnership to build the first Jimmy Buffet Margaritaville Beach Resort on a six acre site on the broadwalk. This island-themed family-friendly resort will feature shops, restaurants and an immense outdoor entertainment area. A convenient Trolley service runs Wednesdays through Sundays, 10 a.m.-10 p.m. offering a nostalgic way to get to and from the best sites on the beach and downtown. For more information:

Call: (954) 924-2980 or visit www.visithollywoodfl.org

description:
Welcome to the Hampton Inn & Suites-Homestead and all of South Florida’s famous fun, beauty and adventure. It’s here that you will find quick access to the area’s best recreation, entertainment, dining and commerce. Located just 30 minutes from exciting Miami and the Beaches and only 20 minutes from the calm relaxation of the Florida Keys, Hampton Inn & Suites-Homestead is a choice destination and perfect accommodation for those seeking Florida’s sun and fun lifestyle.

Easy to find, this Hampton Inn & Suites is located at the Florida Turnpike exit #2 and Campbell Drive in the historic town of Homestead, Florida. Founded as a turn-of-the-century destination, accessible via Henry Flagler’s Florida railway, Homestead has grown into one of the nation’s fastest growing cities while still retaining much of its quaint, small town atmosphere and friendly community spirit.

Bordered on the west by the wildly exotic Everglades National Park, the famous Florida Keys to the south and the cool blue of Biscayne Bay National Park to the east, this Hampton Inn & Suites is truly in one of the world’s most beautiful and vibrant locations.

Take a short, 3 to 5 minute drive from the property to arrive at Florida’s newest, state-of-the-art medical facilities, the exciting Homestead/Miami Speedway and Homestead Air Reserve Base. Closer in, you will find movies, shopping, dining and a host of other destinations within walking distance of the hotel.

Onsite, we have custom crafted many features and amenities to ensure your stay is comfortable and memorable. Surrounding the hotel is a lush wrap of tropical, Florida landscaping, Royal, Queen and Christmas Palms, colorful blooming foliage and deep leafy greens mixed with delightful, variegated varieties along pavered walkways.

Once inside the lobby you are met with vibrant local colors, brilliant greens and reds accented by fine tiles and hardwoods. From our expanded dining and internet cafe to state-of-the-art fitness and meeting facilities, to cool breezes on the lanai overlooking the pool and waterfall, Hampton Inn & Suites-Homestead captures the all flair and feel of this top, international destination.

description: Tucked away in the corner of Northwest Florida, you will find true paradise, beautiful beaches, bays and rivers. title: Breakfast with a Ranger
description: Nestled in the South Walton Beaches is the Gregory E. Moore RV Resort, which is part of Topsail Hill Preserve State Park. The park has 156 quality RV sites with full hook-ups including 30amp, 50amp, sewer, water and cable. The park also has 32 beautiful cabins available to reserve and 22 tent camping sites.  Attractions include paved and natural surface trails, wildlife viewing, 3.2 miles of white sand beaches, and regularly scheduled educational programs.  A tram is available to take visitors from the day-use area and campground to the beach. Topsail Hill Preserve State Park is rated in the top one percent of all RV parks.

title: ArtsPark Saturday Market
description:
Hollywood is a classic Florida beachtown that’s enchanted visitors since the 1920s. Visitors love the Hollywood Trolley which provides a scenic way to enjoy the best of Hollywood Beach and Downtown. Hollywood Beach features a one-of-a-kind oceanfront promenade called the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk that stretches nearly two and a half miles along the Atlantic. Named one of America’s Best Beach Boardwalk’s by Travel + Leisure magazine, this brick-paved thoroughfare is a haven for joggers, bicyclists, roller-bladers and all who’d prefer to take in the action from the comfort of one of the countless eateries and café’s along the way.

The easy ocean access and village-like feel make this a can’t miss destination with numerous highly-rated restaurants, small inns and hotels right on the broadwalk adding to its yesteryear charm. Family dining becomes stress-free, as Mom’s and Dad’s kick back to enjoy a seaside meal while their little ones entertain themselves in the sand just steps away. Two broadwalk parks attract kids of all ages to play paddleball at the historic Garfield Street courts or cool off in the whimsical dolphin play fountain. Locals rave about Josh’s Organic Market which sets up shop on the south end of the Hollywood Broadwalk every weekend selling garden fresh produce and blending a variety of mouth-watering exotic, tropical smoothies from its seaside stand. City leaders recently voted to move forward with a public/private partnership to build the first Jimmy Buffet Margaritaville Beach Resort on a six acre site on the broadwalk. This island-themed family-friendly resort will feature shops, restaurants and an immense outdoor entertainment area. A convenient Trolley service runs Wednesdays through Sundays, 10 a.m.-10 p.m. offering a nostalgic way to get to and from the best sites on the beach and downtown. For more information:

Call: (954) 924-2980 or visit www.visithollywoodfl.org

title: Jammin Jensen
description:
"Florida as it was meant to be." No crowds, no lines, no parking meters, no high rises.
Located just north of Palm Beach International Airport and two hour drive from both Miami and Orlando.

Whether escaping from 50-hour work weeks, cold temperatures, or just the same old grind, come discover Startm Martin County, Florida and its surrounding ities to see what you have been missing. Catering to young and old alike, families, couples or groups, Martin County is your escape for antique hunting, renewing the spirit on a pristine beach, exploring the wonders of nature, or practicing your golf swing.Shopping in the historic downtowns and villages of Stuart, Jensen Beach, Hobe Sound and Port Salerno, offers a bouquet of boutiques, top-rated restaurants, art galleries and museums.

Families with children can escape to Martin County’s, one-of-a-kind marine center Florida Oceanographic Coastal Science Center to let the kids hand-feed sting rays, or take a river cruise to learn more about the Indian River Lagoon estuary, the largest ecosystem in North America boasting 800 species of fish. 
 
Naturalists will find miles of hiking trails, kayak adventures, and ocean Beaches. Here you will find no high-rise buildings and no crowds. Martin County has taken great care to preserve its natural beauty while offering some of the finest recreational activities in the state.

title: Thursday LOL @ Costa d\'Este Beach Resort
description:
A haven from the ordinary amid a sea of opportunity Costa d’Este Beach Resort is a Four-Star level, full service Personal Luxury Resort featuring 94 deluxe rooms, including four suites. Enjoy our destination restaurant, and our full service bar featuring indoor and outdoor seating. Cool off in our pool or relax and unwind at our pool bar. Break a sweat in our extensive fitness center, or loosen up in our luxury spa. Meeting facilities are available for banquets and special events. Costa d’Este Beach Resort, Benchmark Hospitality’s newest Personal Luxury Resort is located ocean-side in Vero Beach, renowned for superb white sand beaches and rolling surf, appealing to beach strollers and wave riders alike. Recognized nationally as an upscale beach community, Vero Beach is also known for its relaxed atmosphere and friendly locals where the beauty and benefits of a charming, home-town atmosphere have been successfully integrated with cosmopolitan flavor, reflected in the abundance of arts and cultural venues and a top 10 ranking of best art towns in the country. Located on The Treasure Coast of Florida a gracious seaside hamlet and environmental gem.

Our onsite restaurant Oriente is designed to be a destination dining and entertainment experience, specializing in Cuban cuisine, with the influence of Spanish, Latin, and Creole traditions as interpreted by the Oriente region of Cuba. The restaurant includes a semi-open kitchen, engaging guests in the culinary preparation experience by providing glimpses through peek-a-boo windows. The focus of the culinary production in this area is little plates, or Cuban Tapas, which are made available in the Oriente Bar and Pool Bar as well as the main restaurant. Costa d’Este’s banquet menu retains the integrity of the Oriente concept while accommodating traditional expectations and requirements.
At Costa d’Este Spa let us indulge your senses and pamper your inner self, with a variety of signature treatments and products created to enhance the body and spirit, and rejuvenate and replenish your vitality. Or recharge yourself at our fitness center, featuring state-of-the art cardio and weight training equipment.
Pool and Beach Access - Our beachfront location gives you access to the pristine shoreline of Vero Beach. Play in the sand and surf, or relax in the sun at the resort’s outdoor pool while enjoying a cocktail from our pool bar.

title: Road To Victory Museum
description:
"Florida as it was meant to be." No crowds, no lines, no parking meters, no high rises.
Located just north of Palm Beach International Airport and two hour drive from both Miami and Orlando.

Whether escaping from 50-hour work weeks, cold temperatures, or just the same old grind, come discover Startm Martin County, Florida and its surrounding ities to see what you have been missing. Catering to young and old alike, families, couples or groups, Martin County is your escape for antique hunting, renewing the spirit on a pristine beach, exploring the wonders of nature, or practicing your golf swing.Shopping in the historic downtowns and villages of Stuart, Jensen Beach, Hobe Sound and Port Salerno, offers a bouquet of boutiques, top-rated restaurants, art galleries and museums.

Families with children can escape to Martin County’s, one-of-a-kind marine center Florida Oceanographic Coastal Science Center to let the kids hand-feed sting rays, or take a river cruise to learn more about the Indian River Lagoon estuary, the largest ecosystem in North America boasting 800 species of fish. 
 
Naturalists will find miles of hiking trails, kayak adventures, and ocean Beaches. Here you will find no high-rise buildings and no crowds. Martin County has taken great care to preserve its natural beauty while offering some of the finest recreational activities in the state.

title: Shipwreck! Pirates & Treasure
description:
When the most frequent assessment of your organization is ‘that’s really cool’, you know you’re in the right business. The mission of GWIZ – The Science Museum is to be the gateway for lifelong adventures in science The real agenda behind the mission is to ignite imaginations… to show that the world around us is amazing, breathtaking and full of unanswered questions. GWIZ operates a 33,000 sq ft center, interactive gallery, critter habitat and Fab Lab. In addition they offer year-round programming for residents, school groups, community groups and tourists.

Visit the new GWIZ Faulhaber Fab Lab!


Have you ever wanted to invent something—and build it from scratch?Around the world, citizen scientists and grassroots tinkerers are doing exactly that. You name it, they’re building it—from a lawn-mowing robot to a GPS sheep tracker to an alarm clock that crawls away when you hit the snooze alarm. Often, the place they’re building these gadgets is in a fabrication laboratory—or “fab lab” for short.


What is a Fab Lab? Basically, it’s a high-tech, small-scale workshop that—thanks to advances in material science and computer-controlled tools—can manufacture nearly anything a mass production factory can. The concept originated at MIT and it’s been changing the world since.

title: New Year\'s Eve in Key Largo
description: Experience the fabulous Florida Keys at the Holiday Inn Key Largo Hotel. Absorb yourself in all that they have to offer. Stroll along their marina and paved pathways through lush foliage to find the two heated outdoor pools, cascading waterfall, Jacuzzi and pool deck. Enjoy a tropical cocktail at the Tiki Bar or savor a delicious meal at Bogie's Cafe and Garden Terrace. With spacious, well-appointed rooms overlooking paradise and the marina, the Holiday Inn Key Largo Hotel is "the perfect place."

title: New Year\'s Eve in Key Largo!
description: This recently converted Courtyard by Marriott 91-room resort is located on a deep-water marina. All rooms are oversized with balconies and Marriott lush bedding package. Amenities include pool, Jacuzzi, sport fishing, scuba diving, snorkeling, glass bottom boat, boat rentals, parasailing, walk to shopping, lighted tennis courts, fitness room, media room, Marketplace, The Bistro restaurant - open for Breakfast serving Starbucks Coffee and dinner.

title: 80th ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION
description: Welcome to the legendary 'Tween Waters Inn on beautiful Captiva Island. Shouldn't every day be this good? Here, across 13 gorgeous Gulf-tween-bay acres, you can enjoy 137 quality accommodations including historic one, two and three bedroom seaside cottages, suites, studios and guest rooms. Miles of sugar-sand beaches. Olympic-size pool, hot tubs and children's wading pool. Day spa. Marina for launch, dock or rental. Fitness center, tennis, kayak and eco-adventures. title: Fishermen\'s Village New Year\'s Eve Celebration
description: Fishermen's Village is your vacation destination for harbor-side shopping, dining and fun!  What once was a fishing village, today is a bustling waterfront destination, the gem of Punta Gorda, FL!  Enjoy unique shops and boutiques, restaurants, 140-slip marina, military heritage museum, 47 spacious daily and weekly vacation villa rentals, fishing charters, harbor cruises,  boat and kayak rentals, bicycles, heated swimming pool, live entertainment and special events.  Our beautiful, spacious villas are 1,000 sq. feet, sleep up to six, have a full kitchen, bath, loft and magnificent views of Charlotte Harbor.  Our Award winning marina is full service with a staff that caters to your every need! Our shops and boutiques carry unique, one of a kind selections.  Village Restaurants offer  the freshest seafood selections, tender steaks and chef's creations sure to delight!  Live entertainment is featured throughout the week either in the Village Center Court or at Harpoon Harry's at the end of the pier.  Special events and activities are held year round.  People come from all over the world to visit us, come see why!

title: LIVE CARIBBEAN MUSIC SUNDAYS POOLSIDE AT THE BILTMORE
description: Set on a 150-acre oasis of privacy and beauty, the Biltmore is the standard for elegance and sophistication. Guest rooms and suites are individually styled and feature up-to-date technologies and comforts. Clef d’Or Concierge and highly personalized service assure guests a memorable experience. A complete destination with exceptional dining, a Donald Ross-designed golf course, world-famous pool, cabana suites, fitness centre and 12,000sf spa, lighted tennis center, recreational cooking school and more.

title: Twilight Farmers\' Market
description: A luxurious full-service condominium resort located at Tarpon Point Marina in Cape Coral with 19 stories of sweeping views of the Caloosahatchee River, San Carlos Bay and the Gulf of Mexico. Richly-appointed furnishings and accommodations, concierge services, award winning spa and salon on site, an upscale restaurant and bar, dockside bar and grill, silver king gourmet market and deli featuring freshly made Gelato, 24 hour fitness center, sundecks, three outdoor pools and spa. Enjoy a variety of the finest shops at MarinaVillage with waterfront restaurants, cafés and a clean deep-water marina with 175 boat slips. The MarinaVillage experience begins when you check in at our signature octagonal reception center showcasing a stunning water feature. This unique glass pavilion will serve as a sparkling beacon for all those arriving at MarinaVillage by land, sea and air. Nearby pavilions along the esplanade offer casual waterfront restaurants and cafes, boutiques, specialty shops and a ship store. The Resort at MarinaVillage offers you all the amenities of Tarpon Point Marina including four star waterfront views - plus hotel-style luxuries such as room service, housekeeping and professional concierge services. Studio, 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom residences range up to 2,225 square feet, with grand rooms, master suites, guest suites, dining terraces and access to amenity decks.

title: Saturday DIRTcar Races at Volusia Speedway Park
description: Experience spectacular natural beauty. See fascinating birds and wildlife. Offering legendary fishing, houseboat rentals, sparkling springs and scenic parks along the St. Johns American Heritage River. Visit the award-winning Main Street with its unique shopping and dining. Southern Hospitality. Memorable attractions and museums. Exciting festivals. Free visitor's guide.

title: Brevard Manatees Vs. Charlotte Stone Crabs
venue: Florida\'s Space Coast Office of Tourism
description: Visit Florida's Space Coast, Orlando's closest beaches (just one hour east) and home to NASA's Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex, US Astronaut Hall of Fame and Port Canaveral Cruises to the Bahamas and Caribbean.  Offering plenty of eco-tourism opportunities at Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge, Brevard Zoo, Canaveral National Seashore and the Indian River Lagoon.  There's great fishing on the freshwater St. Johns River and on the saltwater Indian River Lagoon as well as deep-see angling in the Atlantic Ocean.  Over 25 golf courses will challenge the beginner or pro.  Be sure to check our website for Special Offers and an easy way to reserve your hotel room!  Email or call for the Space Coast Vacation Planner listing all our accommodations and attractions.

title: The Players Championship
venue: Courtyard By Marriott Jacksonville Flagler Center
description: The AWARD WINNING Courtyard by Marriott hotel in Jacksonville at Flagler Center welcomes travelers to Jacksonville, Florida home of the NFL Jacksonville Jaguars & the PGA tour. Our newly constructed hotel is just 10 minutes from downtown Jacksonville and a quick 20- minute drive to the Jacksonville Beaches. While staying with us, take advantage of our close proximity to St. Augustine, JT Butler Blvd, Deerwood business district, Baymeadows Road, Baptist Hospital, the Mayo Clinic, GM, Citi group, Allstate and world-class TPC golf! Outfitted with Marriott's plush bedding and contemporary furnishings; comfort and convenience are guaranteed! Complimentary high-speed wireless Internet ensures you are never out of touch. Our meeting room allows for affordable events and our attentive staff will deliver true Marriott hospitality. The Courtyard Cafe serves a bountiful breakfast buffet with a la carte options. Relax with your colleagues in our trendy lobby bar with a light fare dinner menu and cocktails served Monday through Thursday.

title: 2011 MS Bike Ride
description:
Bayside Inn Key Largo is a "mid-boutique" property located in the heart of beautiful Key Largo.  Conveniently located close to John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park (only living -coral barrier reef in the U.S), the destination offers unprecedented diving, boating, fishing, nature trails, swim with dolphin programs and more!   

Bayside Inn is set directly on the water and amongst a collection of native coconut and bamboo palm trees.  Our 56 guest room hotel features newly renovated accommodations, each with 42" Plasma TV, refrigerator, microwave, tile flooring and complimentary wireless internet.  Enjoy our daily continental breakfast (served in the lobby) at no additional cost.

We invite you to engage in our unique and special property and look forward to hosting you soon.

title: 2011 Keys 100 - Individual Ultra Marathon and Team Relay Marathon
description:
Bayside Inn Key Largo is a "mid-boutique" property located in the heart of beautiful Key Largo.  Conveniently located close to John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park (only living -coral barrier reef in the U.S), the destination offers unprecedented diving, boating, fishing, nature trails, swim with dolphin programs and more!

title: 26th Annual Joe Kiefer Golf Tournament
description:
At the northern end of the Tampa Bay area, beautiful Pasco County is close to major cities but far from the hustle and bustle. Visit Pasco and enjoy Florida the way it used to be. Acres of pristine wilderness with biking, hiking and canoeing trails. Historic downtowns with fine restaurants and antique shops and dozens of family-oriented activities and sporting events year 'round. Pasco County is home to world-class tennis and golf resorts, including Saddlebrook Resort & Spa, one of Conde Nast Traveler's Top 100 and Lake Jovita, the Florida course that plays like North Carolina. 


Enjoy cultural treasures, such as the Historic Courthouse, built in 1909 in beautiful downtown Dade City and the Pioneer Florida Museum, home to period buildings dating to 1878. Experience historic walking tours of downtown New Port Richey, boat tours of the Pithlachascotee River and trolley tours in downtown Dade City. See the World War II Barracks Museum in Zephyrhills, the St. Leo Abbey & Grotto in St. Leo and an original "Cracker House'' in Holiday. Camp at Starkey Wilderness Park, cast your fishing line at Anclote River Park, paddle a kayak at Werner Boyce Salt Spring State Park. Hike the Suncoast Trail, visit spots along the Great Florida Birding Trail or charter a deep sea fishing excursion.


From the beaches on the Gulf Coast to scenic rivers like the Withlacoochee in the east to one of the world's premier drop zones at Skydive City, Pasco has something for everyone. See local and national acts perform at the Show Palace in Hudson and historic Richey Suncoast Theater in New Port Richey. Savor locally-made wines at the Florida Estates Winery in Land O' Lakes. Enjoy dozens of unique festivals, including Chasco Fiesta in New Port Richey and the Kumquat Festival in Dade City.

Sandestin is your one-stop for family fun all year long.

description: The  Country Inn & Suites Vero Beach hotel welcomes you to our beautiful sunny Florida surroundings.  This relaxing hotel features over 60 upscale guestrooms, state-of-the-art amenities, meeting room for groups up to 35, and a relaxing outdoor pool.  Also, you may want to shop until you drop at The Outlets at Vero Beach that are within walking distance from the hotel, or at Indian River Mall just a quick drive along Highway 60.
